scope: Frozen llama.cpp PR #27742 HIP semantic kernel budget for exact UD-Q4_K_XL pp508/tg32 shapes

software.build: Release AMDGPU_TARGETS=gfx1151, HIP graphs, MMQ MFMA, no VMM

commands.pp508: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace -f csv -o llama-qwen4exp-hip-pp508 -d /tmp -- /tmp/qwen4exp-hip-bench-build/bin/llama-bench -m <first-part> -p 508 -n 0 -r 1 --no-warmup -o json -ngl 999 -ctk bf16 -ctv bf16 -fa auto
commands.tg32: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace -f csv -o llama-qwen4exp-hip-tg32 -d /tmp -- /tmp/qwen4exp-hip-bench-build/bin/llama-bench -m <first-part> -p 0 -n 32 -r 1 --no-warmup -o json -ngl 999 -ctk bf16 -ctv bf16 -fa auto

comparison.finding: similar launch order of magnitude; quantized contraction kernel wall is binding

comparison_policy: Same physical host/artifact/KV/source identity. rocprof inflates wall/submission and each command has one no-warmup repetition; use kernel-family durations, geometry, and relative budget—not profile tok/s—as the actionable reference. Vulkan remains the faster end-to-end ceiling but has no rocprof trace.
decision: Target llama-style selected Q4_K/Q5_1/Q8_0 MMQ/cooperative grids inside the retained exact MoE graph structure. Do not infer that fewer kernel rows alone explain performance.
